correction_note.se_0.0074_definition: std(d_s, ddof=1)/sqrt(600) with d_s = ua + ub - 1 as above (std ~0.181); it is the standard error of the mis-defined quantity, not of the paired dU. That is why no correct definition (sequential pairing, S3-estimator U, WDL, per-game n=1200) reproduces it. Correct se = std(ua - ub, ddof=1)/sqrt(600) = 0.02065783
